symbols.name: DevKitApplicationBuilderConfigurationExtensions
symbols.summary: Marks the end of configuration composition on a DevKit application builder.
symbols.remarks: Features that rewrite configuration, such as linked-worktree development isolation, register an action under BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.DevKitBuilderProperties.ConfigurationCompletion. Extensions that read configuration while registering, such as logging and module registration, call BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.DevKitApplicationBuilderConfigurationExtensions.CompleteConfiguration%60%601(%60%600) first.

symbols.name: CompleteConfiguration(TBuilder)
symbols.summary: Runs the registered configuration completion action once. Later calls do nothing.
